75500.commentary: (NIDD1) sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhamman'ti. sambodhi vuccati catūsu maggesu ñāṇaṃ paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ… dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo vīmaṃsā vipassanā sammādiṭṭhi. taṃ sambodhiṃ bujjhitu'kāmassa anubujjhitu'kāmassa paṭibujjhitu'kāmassa sambujjhitu'kāmassa adhigantu'kāmassa phassitu'kāmassa sacchikātu'kāmassā'ti, sambodhikāmassa.

examples.text: vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.

75501.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathānudhamma
75501.meaning1: according to the Dhamma; in accordance with the teaching
75501.commentary: (NIDD1) yath'ānudhamman'ti katame bodhiyā anudhammā? sammāpaṭipadā anulomapaṭipadā apaccanīkapaṭipadā aviruddhapaṭipadā anvatthapaṭipadā dhamm'ānudhammapaṭipadā sīlesu paripūrakāritā indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññutā jāgariy'ānuyogo satisampajaññaṃ, ime vuccanti bodhiyā anudhammā. atha vā catunnaṃ maggānaṃ pubbabhāge vipassanā, ime vuccanti bodhiyā anudhammā'ti, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ. (SNPa) yath'ānudhammaṃ… anudhammo

examples.text: vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.

75502.meaning1: anger and arrogance; rage and pride
75502.commentary: (NIDD1) kodh'ātimānassa vasaṃ na gacche'ti. kodho'ti yo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto… caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anattamanatā cittassa. atimāno'ti idh'ekacco paraṃ atimaññati jātiyā vā gottena vā… aññatar'aññatarena vā vatthunā.

examples.text: kodh'ātimānassa vasaṃ na gacche, mūlam'pi tesaṃ palikhañña tiṭṭhe, athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā, addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyya.

75503.meaning1: wandering self-restrained; walking around in a controlled manner
75503.commentary: (NIDD1) yatacāri gāme'ti gāme yato yatto paṭiyatto gutto gopito rakkhito saṃvuto'ti, so tesu gutto yatacāri gāme. (SNPa) yatacārī'ti saṃyatavihāro, rakkhit'iriyāpatho rakkhitakāyavacīmanodvāro cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. yaticārī'ti'pi pāṭho, so'y'ev'attho.

examples.text: annañ'ca laddhā vasanañ'ca kāle, mattaṃ so jaññā idha tosan'atthaṃ, so tesu gutto yatacāri gāme, rusito'pi vācaṃ pharusaṃ na vajjā.

75504.commentary: (NIDD1) upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto'ti. catutthe jhāne upekkhaṃ ārabbha ek'aggacitto avikkhittacitto avisāhaṭamānaso'ti, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto. (SNPa) upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto'ti catutthajjhān'upekkhaṃ uppādetvā samāhitacitto.

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.

75505.grammar: pp of na vi saṃ √har, neg
75505.commentary: (NIDD1a) uddhaccavicikicchāvaseneva cittaṃ visāhaṭaṃ nāma hoti, ito c'ito ca harīyati, ayaṃ pana evaṃ avisāhaṭamānasassa bhāvo'ti avisāhaṭamānasatā (ADha) akusalacittek'aggatāvasena avisāhaṭassa mānasassa bhāvo avisāhaṭamānasatā.

examples.text: kāmaṃ guhañ'ca duṭṭhā ca, suddhañ'ca paramā jarā, metteyyo ca pasūro ca, māgaṇḍi purābhedanaṃ.

75507.commentary: (SNPa) so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane'ti so brāhmaṇo assakassa ca aḷakassa cā'ti dvinnam'pi rājūnaṃ samāsanne visaye āsanne raṭṭhe, dvinnam'pi raṭṭhānaṃ majjhe'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane, vasi godhāvarīkūle, uñchena ca phalena ca.
aḷakassa patiṭṭhānaṃ, purimāhissatiṃ tadā, ujjeniñ'cā'pi gonaddhaṃ, vedisaṃ vanas'avhayaṃ.

75508.grammar: pp of saṃ ā √sad, irreg form of samāsanna (+gen)
75508.meaning1: near; close by; proximate; in the neighbourhood (of)
75508.commentary: (SNPa) so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane'ti so brāhmaṇo assakassa ca aḷakassa cā'ti dvinnam'pi rājūnaṃ samāsanne visaye āsanne raṭṭhe, dvinnam'pi raṭṭhānaṃ majjhe'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane, vasi godhāvarīkūle, uñchena ca phalena ca.

75509.meaning1: near; close by; proximate; in the neighbourhood (of)
75509.commentary: (SNPa) so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane'ti so brāhmaṇo assakassa ca aḷakassa cā'ti dvinnam'pi rājūnaṃ samāsanne visaye āsanne raṭṭhe, dvinnam'pi raṭṭhānaṃ majjhe'ti adhippāyo.

75510.commentary: (SNPa) godhāvarī kūle'ti godhāvariyā nadiyā kūle. yattha godhāvarī dvidhā bhijjitvā tiyojanappamāṇaṃ antaradīpam'akāsi sabbaṃ kapiṭṭhavanasañchannaṃ, yattha pubbesarabhaṅg'ādayo vasiṃsu, tasmiṃ deseti adhippāyo.

examples.text: so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane, vasi godhāvarīkūle, uñchena ca phalena ca.

75511.commentary: (SNPa) paviṭṭho ca paṇṇasālaṃ pavisitvā suṭṭhu dinnan'ti dānaṃ anumajjanto nisīdi. evaṃ tasmiṃ paṭipaviṭṭhamhi

examples.text: mahāyaññaṃ yajitvāna, puna pāvisi assamaṃ, tasmiṃ paṭipaviṭṭhamhi, añño āgañchi brāhmaṇo.

75512.commentary: (JAa) paṅkadantā'ti dantakaṭṭhassa akhādanena malaggahitadantā. (JAa) paṅkadantā'ti paṅkena malena samannāgatadantā.

examples.text: ugghaṭṭapādo tasito, paṅkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṅkamma, satāni pañca yācati.
khar'ājinā jaṭilā paṅkadantā, dummakkharūpā ye'me jappanti mante, kacci nu te mānusake payoge, idaṃ vidū parimuttā apāyā.

75513.meaning1: with a dusty head; having a dirty head
75513.commentary: (APAa) rajassirā'ti telamakkhan'ādirahitattā dhūlīhi makkhitasīsā'ti attho. (JAa) rajassirānī'ti kilesarajena okiṇṇasīsāni.

examples.text: ugghaṭṭapādo tasito, paṅkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṅkamma, satāni pañca yācati.

75514.meaning1: name of a Brahman ascetic; teacher of the sixteen ascetics in Pārāyanavagga

examples.text: tam'enaṃ bāvarī disvā, āsanena nimantayi, sukhañ'ca kusalaṃ pucchi, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.

75515.commentary: (PVa) saṅghaṃ nimantayī'ti te eva dvādasa bhikkhū saṅghuddesavasena taṃ bhattaṃ dātuṃ nimantesi.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ bāvarī disvā, āsanena nimantayi, sukhañ'ca kusalaṃ pucchi, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.
niyyādayiṃsu therassa, thero saṅghaṃ nimantayi, datvā anvādisi thero, mātu pitu ca bhātuno, suciṃ paṇītaṃ sampannaṃ, anekarasabyañjanaṃ.
yaṃ kho mama deyyadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ visajjitaṃ mayā, anujānāhi me brahme, n'atthi pañcasatāni me.

75517.grammar: fut of na anupadeti, neg, trans (+acc)
75517.meaning1: will not give; will not offer; will not pay
75517.construction:
na + anu + pa + dassa + ti
na + anupadassati
75517.commentary: (DNa) sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anupadassāmā'ti mayaṃ ek'ekassa khettato ambaṇambaṇaṃ āharitvā tuyhaṃ sālibhāgaṃ dassāma, tayā kiñci kammaṃ na kātabbaṃ, tvaṃ amhākaṃ jeṭṭhakaṭṭhāne tiṭṭhā'ti.

examples.text: sace me yācamānassa, bhavaṃ n'ānupadassati, sattame divase tuyhaṃ, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.

75518.meaning1: pierced with the arrow of sorrow

examples.text: ussussati anāhāro, sokasallasamappito, atho'pi evaṃ cittassa, jhāne na ramatī mano.
na so muddhaṃ pajānāti, kuhako so dhan'atthiko, muddhani muddhapāte vā, ñāṇaṃ tassa na vijjati.

75521.meaning1: wide world; sphere of the earth

examples.text: atha ko carahi jānāti, asmiṃ puthavimaṇḍale, muddhaṃ muddh'ādhipātañ'ca, taṃ me akkhāhi devate.
purā kapilavatthumhā, nikkhanto lokanāyako, apacco okkākarājassa, sakyaputto pabhaṅ'karo.

75523.meaning1: attained power through all direct knowledges; (or) attained all direct knowledge and power
75523.commentary: (SNPa) sabbābhiññābalappatto'ti sabbābhiññāya balappatto, sabbā vā abhiññāyo ca balāni ca patto.

examples.text: so hi brāhmaṇa sambuddho, sabbadhammāna pāragū, sabb'ābhiññābalappatto, sabbadhammesu cakkhumā, sabbakammakkhayaṃ patto, vimutto upadhikkhaye.
sāvatthiyaṃ kosalamandire jino, pahūtapañño varabhūrimedhaso, so sakyaputto vidhuro anāsavo, muddh'ādhipātassa vidū nar'āsabho.
tato āmantayī sisse, brāhmaṇe mantapārage, etha māṇavā akkhissaṃ, suṇātha vacanaṃ mama.
āgatāni hi mantesu, mahāpurisalakkhaṇā, dvittiṃsā ca byākkhātā, samattā anupubbaso.

75527.commentary: (NIDD2) tisso'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo. (SNPa) tissametteyyo'ti eko'y'eva esa nāmagottavasena vutto.

examples.text: bāvarissa vaco sutvā, sissā soḷasa brāhmaṇā, ajito tissametteyyo, puṇṇako atha mettagū.
bāvarissa vaco sutvā, sissā soḷasa brāhmaṇā, ajito tissametteyyo, puṇṇako atha mettagū.

75529.commentary: (NIDD2) dhotako'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo'ti, icc'āyasmā dhotako.

examples.text: dhotako upasīvo ca, nando ca atha hemako, todeyyakappā dubhayo, jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito.

75530.commentary: (NIDD2) hemako'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ… abhilāpo'ti, icc'āyasmā hemako.

examples.text: dhotako upasīvo ca, nando ca atha hemako, todeyyakappā dubhayo, jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito.

75531.meaning1: names of two Brahman ascetics; Todeyya and Kappa

examples.text: dhotako upasīvo ca, nando ca atha hemako, todeyyakappā dubhayo, jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito.
bhadr'āvudho udayo ca, posālo c'āpi brāhmaṇo, mogharājā ca medhāvī, piṅgiyo ca mahā-isi.

75533.commentary: (APAa) upāgacchi mahā-isī'ti mahante sīl'ādikhandhe esanato mahā-isi. (CPa) mahā-isī'ti mah'ānubhāvo isi.

examples.text: bhadr'āvudho udayo ca, posālo c'āpi brāhmaṇo, mogharājā ca medhāvī, piṅgiyo ca mahā-isi.
sayam'eva buddhānaṃ mahā-isīnaṃ, sādhūni vākyāni madhūva khuddaṃ, anuttaraṃ bhesajaṃ patthayantā, suṇātha sabbesu pasannacittā.

75534.meaning1: having an individual following; each with a group
75534.commentary: (SNPa) paccekagaṇino'ti visuṃ visuṃ gaṇavanto. (VINt) paccekagaṇīhī'ti visuṃ visuṃ gaṇ'ācariyehi. paccekaṃ gaṇaṃ etesaṃ atthī'ti paccekagaṇino.

examples.text: paccekagaṇino sabbe, sabbalokassa vissutā, jhāyī jhānaratā dhīrā, pubbavāsanavāsitā.
aḷakassa patiṭṭhānaṃ, purimāhissatiṃ tadā, ujjeniñ'cā'pi gonaddhaṃ, vedisaṃ vanas'avhayaṃ.
bāvariṃ abhivādetvā, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, jaṭ'ājinadharā sabbe, pakkāmuṃ uttarāmukhā.

75537.meaning1: with good qualities from previous lives
75537.commentary: (SNPa) pubbavāsanavāsitā'ti pubbe kassapassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajitvā. gatapaccāgata-vatta-puñña-vāsanāya vāsitacittā.

examples.text: paccekagaṇino sabbe, sabbalokassa vissutā, jhāyī jhānaratā dhīrā, pubbavāsanavāsitā.
aḷakassa patiṭṭhānaṃ, purimāhissatiṃ tadā, ujjeniñ'cā'pi gonaddhaṃ, vedisaṃ vanas'avhayaṃ.

75539.commentary: (SNPa) vanas'avhayan'ti pavananagaraṃ vuccati, vanasāvatthin'ti eke. evaṃ vanasāvatthito kosambiṃ, kosambito ca sāketaṃ anuppattānaṃ kira tesaṃ soḷasannaṃ jaṭilānaṃ chayojanamattā parisā ahosi.

examples.text: aḷakassa patiṭṭhānaṃ, purimāhissatiṃ tadā, ujjeniñ'cā'pi gonaddhaṃ, vedisaṃ vanas'avhayaṃ.
kosambiñ'c'āpi sāketaṃ, sāvatthiñ'ca pur'uttamaṃ, setabyaṃ kapilavatthuṃ, kusinārañ'ca mandiraṃ.

75541.commentary: (NIDD2) pāsāṇake cetiye'ti pāsāṇakacetiyaṃ vuccati buddh'āsanan'ti, magadhesu viharanto pāsāṇake cetiye. (SNPa) pāsāṇakaṃ cetiyan'ti mahato pāsāṇassa upari pubbe devaṭṭhānaṃ ahosi. uppanne pana bhagavati vihāro jāto. so ten'eva purimavohārena pāsāṇakaṃ cetiyan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: pāvañ'ca bhoganagaraṃ, vesāliṃ māgadhaṃ puraṃ, pāsāṇakaṃ cetiyañ'ca, ramaṇīyaṃ manoramaṃ.

75542.meaning1: with yellow rays; i.e. the sun
75542.commentary: (APAa) pītaraṃsiṃva bhāṇuman'ti pītaraṃsiṃ saṃkucitapabhaṃ bhāṇumaṃ pabhāvantaṃ candamaṇḍalaṃ iva sambuddhaṃ disvā'ti attho.

examples.text: ath'assa gatte disvāna, paripūrañ'ca byañjanaṃ, ekam'antaṃ ṭhito haṭṭho, manopañhe apucchatha.
ath'assa gatte disvāna, paripūrañ'ca byañjanaṃ, ekam'antaṃ ṭhito haṭṭho, manopañhe apucchatha.

75546.meaning1: together with the vocabulary; with the glossary
75546.commentary: (SNPa) saha nighaṇḍunā ca keṭubhena ca sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ. nighaṇḍū'ti nāmanighaṇḍurukkh'ādīnaṃ vevacanappakāsakaṃ satthaṃ.

examples.text: lakkhaṇe itihāse ca, sanighaṇḍusakeṭubhe, pañcasatāni vāceti, sadhamme pāramiṃ gato.

75547.meaning1: with the liturgies; together with the rules of ritual

examples.text: lakkhaṇe itihāse ca, sanighaṇḍusakeṭubhe, pañcasatāni vāceti, sadhamme pāramiṃ gato.
pucchañ'hi kiñci asuṇanto, sutvā pañhe viyākate, vicinteti jano sabbo, vedajāto katañjalī.

75549.compound: dvanda (saddhā ca sati ca samādhi ca)

examples.text: avijjā muddhā'ti jānāhi, vijjā muddh'ādhipātinī, saddhāsatisamādhīhi, chandavīriyena saṃyutā.

75550.meaning1: destroying the head; demolishing the head; head-splitting
75550.commentary: (SNPa) tattha yasmā catūsu saccesu aññāṇabhūtā avijjā saṃsārassa sīsaṃ, tasmā avijjā muddhā'ti āha. yasmā ca arahattamaggavijjā attanā sahajātehi saddhā-sati-samādhi-kattu'kamyatā-chanda-vīriyehi samannāgatā indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhabhāvam'upagatattā taṃ muddhaṃ adhipāteti, tasmā vijjā muddh'ādhipātinī'tiādim'āha.

examples.text: avijjā muddhā'ti jānāhi, vijjā muddh'ādhipātinī, saddhāsatisamādhīhi, chandavīriyena saṃyutā.

75551.meaning1: interest and effort; desire and energy

examples.text: avijjā muddhā'ti jānāhi, vijjā muddh'ādhipātinī, saddhāsatisamādhīhi, chandavīriyena saṃyutā.

75552.meaning1: having steadied; having regained composure; having taken heart

examples.text: tato vedena mahatā, santhambhitvāna māṇavo, ek'aṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā, pādesu sirasā pati.

75553.commentary: (APAa) chindāmi sabbasaṃsayan'ti ahosiṃ nu kho aham'atītamaddhānan'tiādikaṃ (ma. ni. 1.18, saṃ. ni. 2.20, mahāni. 174) kālattayaṃ ārabbha uppannaṃ sabbaṃ soḷasavidhaṃ kaṅkhaṃ chindāmi vūpasamemi sabbaso viddhaṃsemī'ti attho.

examples.text: bāvarissa ca tuyhaṃ vā, sabbesaṃ sabbasaṃsayaṃ, kat'āvakāsā pucchavho, yaṃ kiñci manasicchatha.
rūpadakkho ahaṃ ajja, sakyaputtassa sāsane, kaṅkhaṃ sabbaṃ vinodemi, chindāmi sabbasaṃsayaṃ.

75554.grammar: masc, pp of na jināti, neg

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto loko (ajitā'ti bhagavā), vevicchā pamādā nappakāsati, japp'ābhilepanaṃ brūmi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayaṃ.

75555.meaning1: who has seen the source; who knows the origin
75555.commentary: (NIDD2) mūladassāvin'ti bhagavā mūladassāvī hetudassāvī nidānadassāvī sambhavadassāvī pabhavadassāvī samuṭṭhānadassāvī āhāradassāvī ārammaṇadassāvī paccayadassāvī samudayadassāvī. (SNPa) mūladassāvin'ti akusalamūl'ādidassāviṃ.

examples.text: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

75556.meaning1: inflamed with passion for existence; infatuated with the desire to be
75556.commentary: (NIDD2) bhavarāgarattā'ti bhavarāgo vuccati yo bhavesu bhavacchando bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavataṇhā bhavasineho bhavapariḷāho bhavamucchā bhav'ajjhosānaṃ. bhavarāgena bhavesu rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā laggitā palibuddhā'ti, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā. (SNPa) bhavarāgarattā'ti evam'imehi āsīsan'ādīhi bhavarāgen'eva rattā

examples.text: āsīsanti thomayanti, abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.

75557.grammar: aor of na tarati, neg, trans (+acc)
75557.meaning1: did not cross (over); did not make it across; did not escape
75557.commentary: (NIDD2) n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā jātijarāmaraṇaṃ n'ātariṃsu na uttariṃsu na patariṃsu na samatikkamiṃsu na vītivattiṃsu (SNPa) n'ātariṃsu jāti'ādivaṭṭadukkhaṃ na uttariṃsū'ti.

examples.text: āsīsanti thomayanti, abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.
te ce n'ātariṃsu yājayogā, yaññehi jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
atāruṃ jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisā'ti jarāmaraṇaṃ atariṃsu uttariṃsu patariṃsu samatikkamiṃsu vītivattiṃsu.

75560.grammar: pr, caus of tarati, irreg form of tāreti, trans (+acc)
75560.commentary: (NIDD2) tuvaṃ ogham'imaṃ taresī'ti evaṃ kām'oghaṃ bhav'oghaṃ diṭṭh'oghaṃ avijj'oghaṃ tareyyāsi uttareyyāsi patareyyāsi samatikkameyyāsi vītivatteyyāsī'ti, evaṃ tuvaṃ ogham'imaṃ taresi. (SNPa) taresī'ti tareyyāsi.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ sahissāmi pamocanāya, kathaṃkathiṃ dhotaka kañci loke, dhammañ'ca seṭṭhaṃ abhijānamāno, evaṃ tuvaṃ ogham'imaṃ taresi.

75561.meaning1: nature of understanding; principle of true knowledge
75561.commentary: (NIDD2) vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññan'ti vivekadhammaṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. (SNPa) vivekadhamman'ti sabbasaṅkhāra-viveka-nibbāna-dhammaṃ.

examples.text: anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.
ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ rattam'ahaṃ vipassa.

75563.grammar: aor 3rd pl of atāri, irreg form of atāruṃ, trans (+acc & +abl)
75563.meaning1: they crossed (over); they made it across
75563.commentary: (NIDD2) atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisā'ti jātijarāmaraṇaṃ atariṃsu uttariṃsu patariṃsu samatikkamiṃsu vītivattiṃsu.

examples.text: ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbaten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

75564.meaning1: not crossed over the flood; not overcome the deluge
75564.commentary: (NIDD2) brūsi anoghatiṇṇe'ti kām'oghaṃ bhav'oghaṃ diṭṭh'oghaṃ avijj'oghaṃ atiṇṇe anatikkante asamatikkante avītivatte antojātijarāmaraṇe parivattente antosaṃsārapathe parivattente jātiyā anugate jarāya anusaṭe byādhinā abhibhūte maraṇena abbhāhate atāṇe aleṇe asaraṇe asaraṇībhūte.

examples.text: ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbaten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, te ce muni brūsi anoghatiṇṇe, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

75565.commentary: (NIDD2) vimokkho tassa n'āparo'ti n'atthi tassa aparo vimokkho. yena vimokkhena vimucceyya vimutto so. kataṃ tassa vimokkhena karaṇīyan'ti, vimokkho tassa n'āparo. (SNPa) vimokkho tassa n'āparo'ti tassa añño vimokkho n'atthi.

examples.text: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokkho tassa n'āparo.

75566.commentary: (NIDD2) uda paññakappī'ti udāhu aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañc'ābhiññāñāṇena vā micchāñāṇena vā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā kappeti janeti sañjaneti nibbatteti abhinibbattetī'ti, paññāṇavā so uda paññakappī. (SNPa) uda paññakappī'ti udāhu samāpattiñāṇ'ādinā ñāṇena taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā kappayati.

examples.text: nirāsaso so uda āsasāno, paññāṇavā so uda paññakappī, muniṃ ahaṃ sakka yathā vijaññaṃ, taṃ me viyācikkha samantacakkhu.
nirāsaso so na ca āsasāno, paññāṇavā so na ca paññakappī, evam'pi todeyya muniṃ vijāna, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattan'ti.

75567.meaning1: afflicted with old age and death; overcome by aging and dying
75567.commentary: (NIDD2) jarāmaccuparetānan'ti jarāya phuṭṭhānaṃ paretānaṃ samohitānaṃ samannāgatānaṃ. maccunā phuṭṭhānaṃ paretānaṃ samohitānaṃ samannāgatānaṃ, jātiyā anugatānaṃ jarāya anusaṭānaṃ byādhinā abhibhūtānaṃ maraṇena abbhāhatānaṃ atāṇānaṃ aleṇānaṃ asaraṇānaṃ asaraṇībhūtānan'ti, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ.

examples.text: majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ'ca me dīpam'akkhāhi, yathā'y'idaṃ n'āparaṃ siyā.

75568.commentary: (NIDD1a) asaraṇībhūtā'ti sayaṃ saraṇakiccaṃ na karontī'ti asaraṇībhūtā. (PMa) asaraṇībhūto'ti pure uppattiyā attano abhāven'eva asaraṇo, uppattisamakālam'eva asaraṇībhūto'ti attho. (MNt) asaraṇībhūtan'ti sabbakālam'pi appaṭisaraṇaṃ. (VISMa) saraṇan'ti gahetuṃ ayuttatāya asaraṇībhūtato. anassādato'ti idaṃ pāḷiyaṃ n'atthi. sati ca tecattālīsa ākārā siyuṃ. rūpappavattiyaṃ sabbādīnavūpaladdhiyā ādīnavato. samudayato atthaṅ'gamato'ti idaṃ dvayaṃ yathā aniccato dassanaṃ panāḷikāya, niccasāravirahadīpanena vā suññatāvibhāvanaṃ hoti, evaṃ suññatāvibhāvanan'ti katvā vuttaṃ.

75569.meaning1: old age and death; aging and dying
75569.commentary: (NIDD2) jarāmaccuparetānan'ti jarāya… maccunā phuṭṭhānaṃ paretānaṃ samohitānaṃ samannāgatānaṃ

examples.text: majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ'ca me dīpam'akkhāhi, yathā'y'idaṃ n'āparaṃ siyā.
akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, etaṃ dīpaṃ anāparaṃ, nibbānaṃ iti naṃ brūmi, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ.

75570.meaning1: extinction of aging and dying; destruction of old age and death
75570.commentary: (NIDD2) jarāmaccuparikkhayan'ti jarāmaraṇassa pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānan'ti, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ.

examples.text: akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, etaṃ dīpaṃ anāparaṃ, nibbānaṃ iti naṃ brūmi, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ.

75571.commentary: (NIDD2) jatukaṇṇī'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa gottaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro'ti, icc'āyasmā jatukaṇṇi. (NIDD2) jatukaṇṇī'ti bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gottena ālapati.

examples.text: dhotako upasīvo ca, nando ca atha hemako, todeyyakappā dubhayo, jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito.
sutvān'ahaṃ vīram'akāmakāmiṃ, (icc'āyasmā jatukaṇṇi) ogh'ātigaṃ puṭṭhum'akāmam'āgamaṃ, santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

75572.commentary: (APt) jatu viya jatukā, upamāne ko, rāmaṭhe jatukaṃ camma-patta-jatu-karesu thī'ti hi rabhaso.

75573.meaning1: who has abandoned pleasure; who has left behind delight
75573.commentary: (NIDD2) nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttan'ti nandī vuccati taṇhā. yo rāgo sārāgo… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ. sā nandī sā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. tasmā buddho nandiñ'jaho. (SNPa) nandiñ'jahan'ti anāgatarūp'ādipatthanājahaṃ. ekā eva hi taṇhā thutivasena idha nānappakārato vuttā.

examples.text: okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.

75574.meaning1: who has abandoned mental fabrication; who has left imagination behind
75574.commentary: (NIDD2) kappā'ti dve kappā, taṇhākappo ca diṭṭhikappo ca… ayaṃ taṇhākappo… ayaṃ diṭṭhikappo. buddhassa bhagavato taṇhākappo pahīno diṭṭhikappo paṭinissaṭṭho. taṇhākappassa pahīnattā diṭṭhikappassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā tasmā buddho kappañ'jaho. (SNPa) kappañ'jahan'ti duvidhakappajahaṃ.

examples.text: okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.

75575.meaning1: devoid of the perception of forms; without awareness of materiality
75575.commentary: (NIDD2) vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti katamā rūpasaññā? rūp'āvacarasamāpattiṃ samāpannassa vā upapannassa vā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārissa vā saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ, ayaṃ rūpasaññā. vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti catasso arūpasamāpattiyo paṭiladdhassa rūpasaññā vibhūtā honti vigatā atikkantā samatikkantā vītivattā'ti, vibhūtarūpasaññissa. (SNPa) vibhūtarūpasaññissā'ti samatikkantarūpasaññissa.

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

75576.meaning1: who has abandoned the whole body; who has left the entire body behind
75576.commentary: (NIDD2) sabbakāyappahāyino'ti sabbo tassa paṭisandhiko rūpakāyo pahīno, tadaṅgasamatikkamā vikkhambhanappahānena pahīno tassa rūpakāyo'ti, sabbakāyappahāyino. (SNPa) sabbakāyappahāyino'ti tadaṅgavikkhambhanavasena sabbarūpakāyappahāyino, pahīna-rūpabhava-paṭisandhikassā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

75577.meaning1: source of nothingness; origin of emptiness
75577.commentary: (SNPa) ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanajanakaṃ kamm'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ ñatvā kin'ti palibodho ayan'ti.

examples.text: ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.
disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo, na tuyhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asut'āmutaṃ vā, atho aviññātaṃ kiñcanam'atthi loke, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

75579.grammar: pr, irreg form of upacchindati, trans (+acc)
75579.meaning1: severs; cuts off; breaks off; completely stops
75579.commentary: (SNPa) takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde'ti kāmavitakkādiṃ takkañ'ca, kāmasaññ'ādiṃ tassa takkassa āsayañ'ca, hatthakukkucc'ādiṃ kukkucciyañ'ca upacchindeyya.

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciyaṃ-upachinde.

75580.meaning1: able to lead to the far shore; suitable for going to Nibbāna
75580.meaningLit: to be gone to the far side
75580.commentary: (NIDD2) pāraṅ'gamanīyā ime dhammā'ti ime dhammā pāraṅ'gamanīyā. pāraṃ pāpenti pāraṃ sampāpenti pāraṃ samanupāpenti, jarāmaṇassa taraṇāya saṃvattantī'ti, pāraṅ'gamanīyā ime dhammā'ti.

examples.text: ekam'ekassa ce'pi pañhassa attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjeyya, gaccheyyeva jarāmaraṇassa pāraṃ. pāraṅ'gamanīyā ime dhammā'ti, tasmā imassa dhammapariyāyassa pārāyanan't'eva adhivacanaṃ.

75581.meaning1: consummate in conduct; accomplished in moral behaviour
75581.commentary: (NIDD2) sampannacaraṇaṃ isin'ti caraṇaṃ vuccati sīl'ācāranibbatti. sīlasaṃvaro'pi caraṇaṃ, indriyasaṃvaro'pi caraṇaṃ, bhojane mattaññutā'pi caraṇaṃ, jāgariy'ānuyogo'pi caraṇaṃ, satta'pi saddhammā caraṇaṃ, cattāri'pi jhānāni caraṇaṃ. sampannacaraṇan'ti sampannacaraṇaṃ seṭṭhacaraṇaṃ viseṭṭhacaraṇaṃ pāmokkhacaraṇaṃ uttamacaraṇaṃ pavaracaraṇaṃ. (SNPa) sampannacaraṇan'ti nibbānapadaṭṭhānabhūtena pātimokkhasīl'ādinā sampannaṃ.

examples.text: ete buddhaṃ upāgacchuṃ, sampannacaraṇaṃ isiṃ, pucchantā nipuṇe pañhe, buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upāgamuṃ.

75582.grammar: aor of pa vi ā √kar, trans (+acc)
75582.construction: pa + vi > vy > by + ā + √kar > kā + si
75582.commentary: (NIDD2) pabyākāsī'ti tesaṃ buddho pabyākāsi ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānī-akāsi pakāsesī'ti, tesaṃ buddho pabyākāsi.

examples.text: tesaṃ buddho pabyākāsi, pañhe puṭṭho yathātathaṃ, pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena, tosesi brāhmaṇe muni.

75583.commentary: (NIDD2) sacc'avhayo'ti sacc'avhayo sadisanāmo sadis'avhayo saccasadis'avhayo. vipassī bhagavā, sikhī bhagavā, vessabhū bhagavā, kakusandho bhagavā, koṇāgamano bhagavā, kassapo bhagavā. te buddhā bhagavanto sadisanāmā sadis'avhayā. bhagavā'pi sakyamuni tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ sadisanāmo sadis'avhayo'ti, tasmā buddho sacc'avhayo. (SNPa) sacc'avhayo'ti buddho'ti saccen'eva avhānena nāmena yutto.

examples.text: tamonudo buddho samantacakkhu, lok'antagū sabbabhav'ātivatto, anāsavo sabbadukkhapahīno, sacc'avhayo brahme upāsito me.

75584.meaning1: with abundant fruit; full of fruit

examples.text: dijo yathā kubbanakaṃ pahāya, bahupphalaṃ kānanam'āvaseyya, evaṃ pahaṃ appadasse pahāya, mah'odadhiṃ haṃso'r'iva ajjhapatto.

75585.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ā + pa + √ap + ta

examples.text: dijo yathā kubbanakaṃ pahāya, bahupphalaṃ kānanam'āvaseyya, evaṃ pahaṃ appadasse pahāya, mah'odadhiṃ haṃso'r'iva ajjhapatto.
eko tamanud'āsino, jutimā so pabhaṅ'karo, gotamo bhūripaññāṇo, gotamo bhūrimedhaso.

75587.meaning1: characterised by wisdom; distinguished by discernment
75587.commentary: (NIDD2) gotamo bhūripaññāṇo'ti gotamo bhūripaññāṇo ñāṇapaññāṇo paññādhajo paññāketu paññ'ādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo. (SNPa) bhūripaññāṇo'ti ñāṇadhajo.

examples.text: eko tamanud'āsino, jutimā so pabhaṅ'karo, gotamo bhūripaññāṇo, gotamo bhūrimedhaso.

75588.meaning1: having that conduct; with that behaviour

75590.commentary: (PMa) paññāya ogāhetvā tassa tassa dhammassa khāyanaṃ pākaṭakaraṇaṃ okkhāyanaṃ, okkhāyanaṃ bahulamassā'ti okkhāyanabahulo.

75591.commentary: (NIDD2) namassamāno vivasemi rattiṃ, ten'eva maññāmi avippavāsaṃ… rattin'divaṃ vivasemi atināmemi atikkamemī'ti, namassamāno vivasemi rattiṃ.

examples.text: passāmi naṃ manasā cakkhunā'va, rattin'divaṃ brāhmaṇa appamatto, namassamāno vivasemi rattiṃ, ten'eva maññāmi avippavāsaṃ.

75592.grammar: pr, from na apeti, neg, intrans (+abl)
75592.meaning1: does not leave; does not stray; does not depart (from)
75592.construction:
na + apa + e + ti
na + apeti
75592.commentary: (NIDD2) n'āpent'ime gotamasāsanamhā'ti ime cattāro dhammā gotamasāsanā buddhasāsanā jinasāsanā tathāgatasāsanā arahantasāsanā n'āpenti na gacchanti na vijahanti na vināsentī'ti, n'āpent'ime gotamasāsanamhā.

examples.text: saddhā ca pīti ca mano sati ca, n'āpenti me gotamasāsanamhā, yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ vajati bhūripañño, sa tena ten'eva nato'ham'asmi.
jiṇṇassa me dubbalathāmakassa, ten'eva kāyo na paleti tattha, saṃkappayantāya vajāmi niccaṃ, mano hi me brāhmaṇa tena yutto.

75595.commentary: (NIDD2) dubbalathāmakassā'ti dubbalathāmakassa appathāmakassa parittathāmakassā'ti, jiṇṇassa me dubbalathāmakassa. (SNPa) dubbalathāmakassā'ti appathāmakassa, atha vā dubbalassa dutthāmakassa ca balavīriyahīnassā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: jiṇṇassa me dubbalathāmakassa, ten'eva kāyo na paleti tattha, saṃkappayantāya vajāmi niccaṃ, mano hi me brāhmaṇa tena yutto.

75596.meaning1: released through faith; liberated through confidence; (or) whose faith is released
75596.commentary: (NIDD2) yathā ahū vakkali muttasaddho, bhadr'āvudho āḷavigotamo cā'ti yathā vakkalitthero… bhadr'āvudho… āḷavigotamo thero saddho saddhāgaruko saddhāpubbaṅ'gamo saddh'ādhimutto saddh'ādhipateyyo arahattappatto'ti, yathā ahū vakkali muttasaddho bhadr'āvudho āḷavigotamo ca.

examples.text: yathā ahū vakkali muttasaddho, bhadr'āvudho āḷavi gotamo ca, evam'eva tvam'pi pamuñcassu saddhaṃ, gamissasi tvaṃ piṅgiya maccudheyyassa pāraṃ.

75597.meaning1: excellent and inferior; high and low
75597.commentary: (SNPa) paro'varan'ti lokiyalok'uttaravasena sundar'āsundaraṃ dūresantikaṃ vā. (SNPa) paro'varan'ti hīnapaṇītaṃ, attano ca parassa ca adhidevattakaraṃ sabbaṃ dhammajātaṃ vedī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: adhideve abhiññāya, sabbaṃ vedi varo'varaṃ, pañhān'antakaro satthā, kaṅkhīnaṃ paṭijānataṃ.

75598.meaning1: memorizer of the discourses; master of the scriptures
